Proposed staging (standard for accelerator cohorts):
1) Upfront validation tranche: $2,500 equivalent in usage credits (voucher) — released on DocuSign sign + basic integration smoke test completed by Foundery dev. This covers initial integration and live testing.
2) Milestone top‑up: $7,500 equivalent — released when Foundery hits either: (a) 10k generated tokens or (b) demo‑ready checklist complete (whichever comes first).
